title: Tech Note: Building Applications Examples – Part 1 XML Keys Editor
featured_technology: Cross-platform (Mac OS X & Windows) build configuration

historical_commentary.text: The foundational note of a well-regarded five-part XML-keys tutorial series; its practical GUI editor tool is tied to the specific XML project-file format used in the 4D 2004/early v11 era, since substantially reworked by later 4D versions and especially by the Project Mode (2018) shift to a fully text-based project structure.
related_updates: 4D's build/compile configuration format has changed considerably since the 4D 2004 era described here
Project Mode (2018+) introduced a git-friendly, fully text-based project structure that changed how build settings and XML-key-equivalent configuration are stored
